source_title: Happy Entrepreneurs? Everywhere? A Meta-Analysis of Entrepreneurship and Wellbeing
evidence_quote: Entrepreneurship can be fulfilling and enhance wellbeing, but also highly stressful and diminish wellbeing. This meta-analytical review synthesizes 319 effect sizes from 94 studies and 82 countries to establish whether individuals derive greater wellbeing from working for themselves or for someone else.
